name: northbase-mcp
description: Read and write your Northbase files directly from Claude
long_description:
Northbase is a local-first file store backed by Supabase. This extension exposes your Northbase files as MCP tools so Claude can read, write, list, and sync them without leaving your conversation.

Authentication uses the session created by `northbase login` — no separate setup required.

tools.name: northbase_get
tools.description: Get the content of a file stored in Northbase by its path

tools.name: northbase_put
tools.description: Write content to a file in Northbase (creates or overwrites)

tools.name: northbase_list
tools.description: List all file paths stored in Northbase, with optional prefix filter

tools.name: northbase_pull
tools.description: Bulk-sync files from Northbase to the local cache

tools.name: northbase_whoami
tools.description: Show the authenticated Northbase user's email and ID

tools.name: northbase_session_status
tools.description: Show session expiry and token refresh status
